scientific_integrity: Analytical derivations plus independent numerical comparisons. Numerical checks corroborate but do not prove the all-parameter theorem. Historical overlap comparisons are best knowledge, not exhaustive.
scientific_limitations: Only the specified two-dimensional stable feedforward linear Langevin system, stationary Gaussian white forcing with positive definite correlated covariance, and a chosen downstream coordinate. No inference of actual network dynamics from a measured peak is claimed. Wider priority remains provisional.
title: A sharp correlated-noise threshold for spectral peaks in an overdamped feedforward Langevin pair
